# The labels the flow uses, as name|color|description. scripts/sync-labels.sh
# creates or updates them on GitHub; release.yml sorts the release notes by
# them and the PR check asks for one kind label on every pull request.
# CONTRIBUTING.md says what each status means and who moves an issue on.
#
# Kind: one per pull request; it decides the release-notes section.
feature|0e8a16|Something the board could not do before
enhancement|a2eeef|A change to something it already does
bug|d73a4a|Something did not work
breaking change|b60205|A change that needs users to do something
docs|0075ca|The README, the guide or other documentation
plugin|5319e7|The Claude Code or Codex plugin: skills, commands, hooks
chore|cfd3d7|Build, CI, refactoring, tests: nothing a user sees
dependencies|0366d6|Pull requests that update a dependency file
# Status: where an issue is. A new issue starts at needs triage.
needs triage|ededed|New: the maintainer has not looked at it yet
needs info|d876e3|Waiting for details from the person who opened it
proposal|c5def5|A change to how the board behaves, discussed before it is built
accepted|0e8a16|Agreed and ready: anyone may take it and open a pull request
in progress|fbca04|Someone has taken it; see the assignee
# Flow
no-issue|fbca04|A pull request small enough to need no issue
skip-changelog|ededed|Left out of the release notes
# Issues
design|c5def5|How the board should behave
feedback wanted|d4c5f9|Waiting for people to try it and say
good first issue|7057ff|Small, well described, a good way in
help wanted|008672|The maintainer would welcome a hand
translation|0075ca|A language of the screen or of the README
question|d876e3|Further information is requested
duplicate|cfd3d7|This issue or pull request already exists
wontfix|ffffff|This will not be worked on
